title: Rotting Oranges
statement: Cells hold 0 for empty, 1 for a fresh orange and 2 for a rotten one. Every minute, any fresh orange edge-adjacent to a rotten one also rots. Return the minutes until no fresh orange remains, or -1 if that never happens.
hints: Rot spreads outward in simultaneous waves, which is breadth-first search, not depth-first.
Seed the queue with EVERY initially rotten orange, so all sources expand together. Count the fresh ones as you go.
Process the queue one full level per minute. At the end, any fresh orange left unreached means -1. Zero fresh oranges at the start means 0.
